original.title: Critical Inquiry in a Text-Based Environment: Computer Conferencing in Higher Education

core_idea: Deep online learning happens in a community of inquiry built from three overlapping presences: social presence, cognitive presence and teaching presence.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How do online or blended courses support deep learning?
How does teaching presence affect students' cognitive presence?
Typical data: CoI survey, content analysis of discussion posts, interviews.
common_mistakes: Measuring only satisfaction and calling it social presence.
Coding discussion posts without the published indicators.
Treating the presences as independent when the model stresses their overlap.
